minecraft:sharpness: Adds 8% base attack damage per level; V = +40%. Penchant replaces vanilla flat Sharpness damage.
minecraft:smite: Adds 2.5 damage per level against the sensitive_to_smite tag; V = +12.5.
minecraft:bane_of_arthropods: Adds 2.5 damage per level against arthropods; also applies Slowness IV with level-scaled random duration.
minecraft:knockback: Adds 1 knockback-effect unit per level; II = +2.
minecraft:fire_aspect: Ignites targets for 4 seconds per level; II = 8s.
minecraft:looting: Increases qualifying equipment-drop probability by 1 percentage point per level. Supported tag includes the pack's crossbow extensions; ordinary loot-table bonuses also depend on the loot table.
minecraft:impaling: Adds 2.5 damage per level against sensitive_to_impaling targets; V = +12.5.
minecraft:riptide: Wet-use trident propulsion strength: 1.5 / 2.25 / 3.0; native movement conditions apply.
minecraft:channeling: Summons lightning on qualifying trident hits during thunder; also has lightning-rod hit handling.
minecraft:density: Adds 0.5 smash damage per fallen block per level; V = +2.5 per block.
minecraft:breach: Reduces target armor effectiveness by 15 percentage points per level; IV = 60 points.
minecraft:wind_burst: Smash-triggered wind explosion, radius 3.5; knockback multiplier 1.2 / 1.75 / 2.2.
minecraft:lunge: Spear lunge: horizontal impulse magnitude 0.458 per level; exhaustion 4 per level and 1 durability cost, with native food/movement restrictions.
minecraft:power: Adds 0.5 per level to arrow damage calculation; V = +2.5. This is an arrow damage input, not a guaranteed +2.5 final HP per hit.
minecraft:punch: Adds 1 arrow knockback-effect unit per level; II = +2.
minecraft:flame: Ignites fired arrows; native projectile fire duration is 100 seconds, distinct from the victim's burn time.
minecraft:infinity: Prevents ammo use for qualifying normal arrows; special-arrow rules remain.
minecraft:quick_charge: Reduces crossbow charge time by 0.25s per level; III = -0.75s.
minecraft:piercing: Adds 1 projectile-piercing unit per level, with CrossArms projectile tagging.
minecraft:multishot: Adds 2 projectiles per level: 3 / 5 / 7 total. Added spread 5 / 8 / 11 degrees; CrossArms function hooks also apply.
minecraft:protection: Adds 0.25 protection points per level: 1% general reduction per level per piece; IV = 4% per piece.
minecraft:projectile_protection: Adds 0.25 projectile-protection points per level: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%.
minecraft:fire_protection: Adds 0.25 fire-protection points per level: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%. Burning duration remains -15% base per level.
minecraft:blast_protection: Adds 0.25 blast-protection points per level: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%. Explosion knockback resistance remains +0.15 per level.
minecraft:feather_falling: Adds 1.5 fall-protection points per level: 6% reduction per level, IV = 24% in the enchantment layer.
minecraft:thorns: 15% proc chance per level; deals random 1-5 damage and costs 2 item durability when it procs.
minecraft:respiration: Adds 1 oxygen_bonus per level; improves underwater breathing through the native oxygen calculation.
minecraft:aqua_affinity: Multiplies submerged mining speed by 5 at level I, removing the usual underwater mining penalty.
minecraft:depth_strider: Adds 1/3 water movement efficiency per level; III = +1.
minecraft:frost_walker: Freezes nearby water with radius 2 + level, maximum 16; grants immunity to the defined hot-floor/campfire sources while active.
minecraft:soul_speed: On soul-speed terrain: movement_speed +0.0405 / +0.051 / +0.0615 and movement efficiency +1. Has a 4% qualifying durability-loss chance.
minecraft:binding_curse: Prevents ordinary removal of equipped cursed armor.
minecraft:vanishing_curse: Prevents the enchanted item from dropping on death.
minecraft:mending: XP repairs 2 durability per XP point through the native repair effect.
minecraft:unbreaking: Armor: ignores 8% of durability loss per level; X = 80% avoidance (about 5x lifespan). Non-armor: L/(L+1) avoidance; X = 90.91%. Max level X.
minecraft:sweeping_edge: HIDDEN. Registered vanilla enchantment; sweep-damage ratio bonus L/(L+1). Not normally obtainable.
minecraft:efficiency: Adds L? + 1 mining_efficiency; V = +26. Included because axes can also be weapons.
minecraft:fortune: No direct attribute: tool loot tables use the enchantment level to change drops.
minecraft:silk_touch: Special block-drop selection; suppresses normal block XP. No combat attribute.
minecraft:lure: Fishing-time reduction +5 per level in the native fishing calculation.
attack_speed_enchantment:attack_speed: Adds 0.1 attack_speed attribute per level; III = +0.3 attacks/s. Flat, not +10% per level.
critical_strike:chance: Adds 4% of base critical_strike:chance per level; V = +20 base-percentage points with the normal base-100 attribute.
critical_strike:damage: Adds 10% of base critical_strike:damage per level; V = +50 critical-multiplier percentage points with the normal base-100 attribute.
ice_enchantments:frost: Sets vanilla frozen ticks to 240 on projectile hits. This is vanilla freezing buildup, not RPG Frozen hard control.
ice_enchantments:frost_aspect: Sets frozen ticks to 300. Both I and II pass a hardcoded effect level of 1, so II currently gives no stronger freeze.
dungeons_arise:discharge: 15% ? level proc definition builds movement Speed through successive hits, then discharges at Speed V into a radius-2 explosion/lightning; can damage the wielder. Some conditional entries use legacy array syntax and require runtime confirmation.
dungeons_arise:ensnaring: 10% / 20% / 30% / 40% chance to apply Slowness XI for 2s and summon surrounding evoker fangs.
dungeons_arise:lolths_curse: 30% chance for Regeneration II for 2-4s; definition also includes 20% cave-spider spawning, 4-8 reflected damage against arthropods and 10s Darkness on players. Some conditions use legacy array syntax.
dungeons_arise:purification: Defined chance 0.5% per level per tick to clear poison/wither and make a radius-2 magic explosion; conditional array syntax needs runtime confirmation.
nova_structures:aerials_bane: Adds 2 damage per level against qualifying airborne/aerial targets; excludes specified water, mounted and bow/crossbow cases.
nova_structures:illagers_bane: Adds 2.5 damage per level against the mod's illager tag; V = +12.5.
nova_structures:wither_coated: Applies Wither I for 12s / II for 6s / III for 3s on qualifying direct hits; +1 item durability damage.
nova_structures:multishot: Tri-Shot: adds 2 bow projectiles (3 total) with 10 degrees additional spread.
nova_structures:piercing: Blowthrough: +1 bow projectile-piercing unit per level; IV = +4.
nova_structures:power: Might: adds 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 to qualifying crossbow arrow damage input.
nova_structures:gravity: Arrow impacts create pulling explosions: negative knockback multiplier -0.75 / -1 / -1.25. Entity-hit radius 6; block hits use several offset bursts, including radius 10.
nova_structures:outreach: Chest armor adds 0.5 block interaction range per level; IV = +2 blocks. This is block reach, not melee reach.
nova_structures:photosynthesis: Repairs 1 item durability on qualifying 1%-chance ticks under specified sky/day or light conditions; no flat combat stat.
nova_structures:conductivity_curse: Conditional lightning-attraction behavior; inspect the saved raw tick conditions for its weather/sky requirements.
nova_structures:hydro_veil: Happy-Ghast harness enchantment: environmental defenses, rain-dependent movement/healing; not player armor. Full conditional attributes are in the raw record.
nova_structures:swift_soar: Happy-Ghast harness flying behavior; not player armor or a player combat stat.
nova_structures:wax_wings: Elytra water-related durability/flight behavior; conditional, not a flat armor bonus.
crossarms:acceleration: Projectile launch impulse magnitude 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6, plus CrossArms orientation correction.
crossarms:ricochet: Stores the enchantment level as the arrow's bounce count: 1-4.
crossarms:zero_drop: Removes arrow gravity; suppresses vanilla and RPG critical hits through the installed repair.
crossarms:frenzy: Automatic crossbow firing with heat/spread and reload rules. Heat damage is 20/30/40/50% normal; slows the shooter and applies high-heat self-damage. See the current CrossArms patch for the complete firing state machine.
sniper_enchantment:sniper: Distance-tiered arrow damage: at V, +1 / +2.5 / +4 / +5.5 / +7 for 10-20 / 20-30 / 30-40 / 40-50 / 50+ blocks. The definition uses array-shaped requirements; runtime validity needs confirmation.
spell_power:spell_power: Adds 5% generic Spell Power per level; V = +25%. Generic power contributes to healing as well as offensive schools.
spell_power:haste: Adds 4% base spell haste per level; V = +20%.
spell_power:critical_chance: Spell Volatility: +4% base spell-critical chance per level; V = +20 points with the normal base-100 attribute.
spell_power:critical_damage: Amplify Spell: +10% base spell-critical damage/healing multiplier per level; V = +50 points with the normal base-100 attribute.
spell_power:energize: Per armor piece: +3% base Healing and Lightning power per level; V = +15% to both.
spell_power:sunfire: Per armor piece: +3% base Arcane and Fire power per level; V = +15% to both.
spell_power:soulfrost: Per armor piece: +3% base Soul and Frost power per level; V = +15% to both.
spell_power:magic_protection: Adds 0.25 protection points per level against c:is_magic damage: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%.
spell_engine:spell_infinity: Prevents consumption of rune ammunition for supported spells; does not waive cooldowns, health costs or every other spell cost.
combat_roll:acrobat: Chest: +20% base roll recharge rate per level; V = +100%. This changes recharge rate, not a flat -100% cooldown.
combat_roll:longfooted: Boots: +1 roll-distance attribute per level; IV = +4.
combat_roll:multi_roll: Helmet: +1 available roll per level; III = +3.
spiky_enchantment:spiky: Held shield retaliates for 2 / 4 / 6 damage through its advancement/function handler; conditional shield durability use.
fangs_enchantment:fangs: Leggings: retaliatory functions summon 1 / up to 2 / up to 3 fangs; extra targets within 2/3 blocks. The 15% ? level roll applies to durability loss, not the separately defined fang summons.
downfall_enchantment:downfall: Boot landing attack: 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 damage within 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 blocks, plus upward motion and Slowness III for 1s. Falling thresholds 3 / 4.5 / 5 / 6 blocks; user gets brief Slowness II/mining-fatigue marker.
enderzoology:repellent: 15% proc chance per level to teleport an attacker 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 blocks; costs 2 item durability on proc.
farmersdelight:backstabbing: Knife hits from behind multiply damage by 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8.
betternether:ruby_fire: Flaming Ruby equipment: +1 knockback when attacking; 50% retaliatory chance for 2-7 magic damage, ignition and pushback, costing 1 durability. Also smelts supported mined ores.
betternether:obsidian_breaker: Mining-only obsidian breaking-speed behavior; no fixed combat attribute in the definition.
betterend:end_veil: Helmet: looking at Endermen does not anger them.
betterend:resonance: Hammer mining breaks surrounding blocks; sneaking limits the effect. No direct combat attribute.
betterarcheology:soaring_winds: Elytra takeoff boost; no flat armor stat in the definition.
betterarcheology:tunneling: Mining digs an additional block below; no combat attribute.
withered_lands:curse_of_starvation: No effect component in the installed definition; any hunger behavior depends on an external handler and is not established by this data audit.

alexscaves:dazing_sweep: Adds a club stun sweep in a box of size L + 1.2: 2.2 / 3.2 blocks at I-II (box size, not radius).
alexscaves:detonating_death: Possessed-mob death explosion strength = 2 + floor(mob width).
alexscaves:double_stab: Desolate Dagger summons two ghostly daggers instead of one.

alexscaves:enveloping_bubble: Sea Staff water bolt can envelop the target in a drowning bubble of water
alexscaves:explosive_flavor: Shotgum fires a single slow, explosive gumball
alexscaves:far_flung: Hook launches even further when swung
alexscaves:ferrous_haste: Galena Gauntlet items attack and mine much faster
alexscaves:field_extension: Galena Gauntlet can move items further away
alexscaves:flinging: Ortholance launch moves the player much further
alexscaves:gamma_ray: Raygun beam inflicts deadly blue Irradiated effect
alexscaves:heavy_slam: Resistor Shield first slam attack deals additional damage
alexscaves:herd_phalanx: Extinction Spear summons 3 + L armored heads: 4 / 5 / 6 at I-III.
alexscaves:impending_stab: Ghostly dagger attack is delayed and deals increased damage
alexscaves:lasting_morale: Deep Ones summoned by Magic Conch will stay around longer
alexscaves:multiple_mint: Sugar Staff summons 3 + L peppermints: 4 / 5 at I-II.
alexscaves:peppermint_punting: Peppermints bounce directly ahead instead of around the attacker
alexscaves:plummeting_flight: Extinction Spear Subterranodon attack carries foes higher and for longer
alexscaves:precise_volley: Dreadbow arrows rain down from the sky to a more central position
alexscaves:rapid_possession: Possessed-mob navigation speed factor = 1.25 + 0.35L: 1.6 / 1.95 / 2.3 at I-III.
alexscaves:relentless_darkness: Dreadbow fires arrows directly ahead in a continuous stream
alexscaves:sated_blade: Ghostly dagger attack increases the food saturation level of the attacker
alexscaves:sea_swing: Ortholance swing attack summons a single, forwards-facing wave
alexscaves:seapairing: Sea Staff can occasionally regain durability when in the inventory of a submerged entity
alexscaves:second_wave: Ortholance summons a second, delayed wave after launching the player
alexscaves:seekcandy: Peppermints created by the staff seek out any entity the attacker looks at
alexscaves:shaded_respite: Dreadbow will not consume normal arrows or durability if fired in darkness
alexscaves:sharp_cane: Hook deals three damage per level when attaching to a target
alexscaves:sightless: Mobs possessed by the Totem of Possession can be controlled without a direct line of sight
alexscaves:soak_seeking: Sea Staff water bolts now home-in on targets more accurately
alexscaves:solar: Raygun recharges over time when user is under direct sunlight
alexscaves:spell_lasting: Hex lifespan = 100 + 60L ticks: 8 / 11 / 14 seconds at I-III.
alexscaves:straight_hook: Hook launches directly ahead and is not hindered by gravity
alexscaves:swiftwood: Primitive Club can be swung much faster
alexscaves:targeted_ricochet: Gumballs will bounce to the nearest target after hitting a wall or entity
alexscaves:taxing_bellow: Using the Magic Conch lowers the opinion held by Deep Ones, but does not decrease durability
alexscaves:triple_splash: Sea Staff fires two additional water bolts
alexscaves:triple_split: Gumballs split into three additional Gumballs after hitting their first target
alexscaves:tsunami: Ortholance launch summons a single, gigantic wave
alexscaves:twilight_perfection: Dreadbow arrows glow red and deal double damage if fired at the precise bow charge time
alexsmobs:board_return: Straddleboard returns instantly to the rider's inventory when broken.
alexsmobs:lavawax: Gives the rider of the Straddleboard Fire Resistance.
alexsmobs:serpentfriend: Makes Bone Serpents neutral towards the rider of the Straddleboard.
alexsmobs:straddle_jump: Increases the height of Straddleboard jumps.
